entities.summary: Dale Kenton Weise is a Canadian former professional ice hockey right winger. He was selected in the fourth round, 111th overall, by the New York Rangers of the National Hockey League (NHL) in the 2008 NHL entry draft. Weise also played for the Vancouver Canucks, Montreal Canadiens, Chicago Blackhawks, and Philadelphia Flyers.
